info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Facility By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows the modification of facility information related to building maintenance based on a specified parameter. Users can update various attributes of a facility, ensuring that the data remains accurate and up-to-date. It is particularly beneficial for facility managers and maintenance teams looking to streamline operations and reflect real-time changes in their maintenance systems. By utilizing this endpoint, organizations can enhance their facility management capabilities efficiently.

patch.description: Allows the user to update specific details regarding the building maintenance for the facility identified by RES-100045. This operation ensures that the maintenance information is current and accurate, enabling better management of the building's operational requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the building maintenance details for the specified facility identified by RES-100045. Ensure all necessary fields are included to successfully process the update.
